training_scope: 14 TSA 23 IDF training plots plus 19 high-biomass IDF plots from BC TSAs 2, 5, 9, 18, 22, and 29; exact FAIB plot support and first-return LidarBC metrics.
source: FAIB Forest Inventory Ground Plots (public PSP, OGL-BC) and LidarBC point clouds (OGL-BC); FEMIC regional open-data fit 2026-10-31.

applicability.notes: Experimental regional candidate. Strict independent BC IDF check: 36 in-range plots, BA RMSE 8.86 m2/ha; the 56-plot expanded set (including 6-11 year fallback) is 8.02. Four-plot TSA 23 high-biomass external check was 6.67. TSA 23 independent subset: 7 plots, BA RMSE 15.02. Not operational.

caveats: Experimental regional candidate; not a published operational card.
Four-plot high-biomass external check is not the full validation set.
